title: rhamnus neapolitana
intro: Rhamnus neapolitana, commonly known as the Naples buckthorn or Italian buckthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rhamnaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may help alleviate conditions such as digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus neapolitana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rhamnus neapolitana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
